chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Isma'il ibn Rabah who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Mufrad al-Umrah, is its Tawaf for women? He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.طَوَافُ: Tawaf: The ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba
key_terms.مُفْرِدِ الْعُمْرَةِ: Mufrad Umrah: Umrah performed independently, distinct from Qiran or Tamattu

ai.seo_question: Is the Tawaf of Umrah valid for women according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (AS) confirms that the Tawaf performed by a man in Mufrad Umrah is valid for women, highlighting the jurisprudential principle that the core ritual acts of Hajj and Umrah are generally gender-neutral unless specified otherwise. This ruling underscores the uniformity of the pilgrimage rites, reinforcing the idea that the spiritual merit and legal validity of circumambulating the Kaaba are not restricted by gender. The brevity of the report reflects the clarity of the Imam's position on this specific point of fiqh, leaving no ambiguity regarding the applicability of the ritual to both sexes.
